description:
## 1.12.0-tairiku.3 (stable, 2026-10-12)

### Morphe patches for X (Twitter) — 3 patches

* **Fix external post links:** Open external X status URLs directly as post details instead of falling back to Home when the For You/Following tabs are hidden. Verified by user screenshot on a patched Android phone on 2026-10-12.
* **Hide Find more:** Narrow recommendation filtering to the related-tweets module and Search recommendations, avoiding the generic tweetdetail entry prefix.
* **Hide Who to follow:** Preserve hiding recommended accounts.
* Verified against X 12.31.0-prod.01 and 12.32.0-prod.01 APK fingerprints and patch application. URL parser regression tests, Gradle bundle tests, and CI build must pass. Other deep-link variants and Android versions are not separately verified.

patches.name: Fix external post links
patches.description: Opens external X post URLs directly in post detail without using the For You tab.

patches.name: Hide Find more
patches.description: Hides Discover more / もっと見つける under posts and top people recommendations in Search.

patches.name: Hide Who to follow
patches.description: Hides Who to follow / recommended-account modules from timelines.

release_notes: Experimental five-patch Morphe bundle. Adds Hide search relevance prompt to hide the Search results yes/no survey. Preserves four previous patches. Static X 12.31/12.32 APK model evidence and CI tests pass; user device testing is pending. Existing Morphe source with prerelease toggle reads dev/patches-bundle.json. Stable main remains unchanged.
